# Generated automatically by OIOS Digital Twin Engine for Tender: saipem_kaminho_rig_move_2026
# Vessel Matched: Topaz Master (87.0T BP) -> Towing Target: Saipem Angola

import bpy
import math

def setup_towing_scene():
    # 1. Clear existing mesh objects
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    bpy.ops.object.select_by_type(type='MESH')
    bpy.ops.object.delete()
    
    # 2. Create Water Surface (Ocean Plane)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_grid_add(size=100, x_subdivisions=40, y_subdivisions=40, location=(0, 0, 0))
    ocean = bpy.context.active_object
    ocean.name = "OceanSurface"
    
    # Add simple wave displacement or material (mocked via ocean modifier)
    ocean_mod = ocean.modifiers.new(name="OceanWaves", type='OCEAN')
    ocean_mod.resolution = 12
    ocean_mod.spatial_size = 50
    ocean_mod.wave_scale = 1.8
    
    # 3. Create Tugboat representation VB TopazMaster
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1.0, calc_uvs=True, enter_editmode=False, align='WORLD', location=(0, 15, 0.8), scale=(2.5, 6.0, 1.5))
    tug = bpy.context.active_object
    tug.name = "Tugboat_Topaz_Master"
    
    # 4. Create Towed Target representation (Saipem Angola)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1.0, calc_uvs=True, enter_editmode=False, align='WORLD', location=(0, -15, 1.2), scale=(4.0, 12.0, 2.5))
    target = bpy.context.active_object
    target.name = "TowedTarget_Saipem_Angola"
    
    # 5. Create Towline (Bezier Curve connecting them)
    bpy.ops.curve.primitive_bezier_curve_add(enter_editmode=False, align='WORLD', location=(0, 0, 0))
    towline = bpy.context.active_object
    towline.name = "Towline_Cable"
    
    # Configure Bezier points
    curve_data = towline.data
    points = curve_data.splines[0].bezier_points
    
    # Start point at Tug stern
    points[0].co = (0, 9, 1.2)
    points[0].handle_right = (0, 5, 0.5)
    points[0].handle_left = (0, 10, 1.5)
    
    # End point at Towed target bow
    points[1].co = (0, -3, 1.8)
    points[1].handle_left = (0, -1, 1.0)
    points[1].handle_right = (0, -5, 2.0)
    
    # Bevel curve to look like a thick steel cable
    curve_data.dimensions = '3D'
    curve_data.bevel_depth = 0.08
    curve_data.bevel_resolution = 4
    
    # 6. Setup Lighting and Camera
    bpy.ops.object.select_by_type(type='LIGHT')
    bpy.ops.object.delete()
    
    bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='SUN', radius=1.0, align='WORLD', location=(10, 10, 25))
    sun = bpy.context.active_object
    sun.data.energy = 4.0
    
    # Set Camera
    cameras = [obj for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects if obj.type == 'CAMERA']
    if cameras:
        cam = cameras[0]
        cam.location = (25, -25, 15)
        cam.rotation_euler = (math.radians(60), 0, math.radians(45))
        
    print("OIOS Digital Twin 3D Towing Scene Setup Complete!")

setup_towing_scene()
